description: This file contains unit tests for the EventHub stream-per-partition data adapter functionality within the Orleans testing framework. It defines a test class with fixture setup, configuration for the test cluster, and a specific test case for streaming to multiple partitions.

classes.name: EHStreamPerPartitionTests
classes.description: Unit test class for EventHub stream-per-partition data adapter functionality, including setup fixtures and test cases.

classes.name: EHStreamPerPartitionTests.Fixture
classes.description: Fixture class to configure and initialize Orleans test cluster environment with EventHub stream provider and data adapter.

classes.name: EHStreamPerPartitionTests.Fixture.MySiloBuilderConfigurator
classes.description: Configures the silo builder with EventHub stream provider, data adapter, and storage.

classes.name: EHStreamPerPartitionTests.Fixture.MyClientBuilderConfigurator
classes.description: Configures the client builder for the Orleans test environment, setting up the EventHub streams and data adapter.

methods.name: EHStreamPerPartitionTests
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the test fixture.

methods.description: Test case that creates streams, subscribes consumers, generates events, and verifies that the events are received across partitions.
